phenomenon: very sparse drug-by-route grid beside a literal-interval construction, with a real compound that must still stay lexical
notes: The DRUG x ROUTE grid is eight drugs by five routes and only seven of forty cells are attested, so the classes have to be generalized from a thin scatter rather than read off a rectangle. INTERVAL is a second, unrelated construction whose numerals contribute their literal hour count (q6 = every six hours), and it is gappy too: q6, q8, q12 and q24 are attested, q4 and q48 are not. Three deliberate negatives. pipTaz is genuinely bimorphemic in the world (piperacillin-tazobactam) but is the only code of its shape, so no slot substitutes and the contrast rule keeps it lexical. Line-protocol numerals are arbitrary identifiers, unlike the interval numerals in the same codebook. The conventional frequency abbreviations qd/bid/tid/qid share a surface q with the interval construction without belonging to it. Domain deliberately outside the device-repair setting the pipeline was developed on.

codebook.D5W: five percent dextrose in water diluent
codebook.L1: line protocol 1, the peripheral short line
codebook.L3: line protocol 3, the tunneled central line
codebook.hood: compounded under the laminar flow hood
